title: Updating the next-ball count
statement: For any counting-algorithm state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, updating its register vector at index $11$ to $z$ gives the register vector of the state obtained by replacing its next-ball count $c$ with $z$.
replaced:
For any state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, updating the vector associated with
$\sigma$ at register index $11$ to $z$ gives the vector associated with the state
obtained from $\sigma$ by replacing its next-ball count $c$ with $z$.
